fixes: Every row of billing_periods.csv is billed as its own invoice, sorted by account and then by start; the engine used to keep one invoice per account and silently drop the account's other rows.
A read is counted on the invoice whose period holds its day, and the period quantities, positions and active days of an invoice come from that row alone.
Active days are counted day by day inside the period over the meter's own windows, which also fixes periods that span two months.
The plan of a row is found by plan name or by one of the plan's codes.
Added the tier revision choice: a plan is rated with the one revision under which every paid invoice on the plan totals its paid amount.
The allowance that no energy line can take is carried to the account's next invoice by start and dropped after the last one.
An invoice gets no credit when the account's previous invoice by start was paid less than its total, which needed the optional payments.csv.
Added the statement document built from vouchers.csv: balance, redeemed voucher ids and what is due.
Every amount in the document is written as a string with exactly two decimals.
Added missing_input so the command line can name the first input file a directory lacks.
